lines.awakening: At the still point, every trace converges.
lines.surge: The water rose four metres, and took the harbour lights with it.
lines.hull: A ship passed at three ten. Its engine is still in the water, somewhere.
lines.song: A single voice, singing at a pitch no other whale answers.
lines.ice: A glacier let go of ten thousand winters, in a single breath.
lines.swell: Waves, from a storm that never reached land.
lines.rain: Rain on the open sea, heard from forty metres down.
lines.thunder: Thunder, far off. No ship logged the weather.
lines.shrimp: A whole reef, crackling at once, like frying light.
lines.icesong: Ice, singing to itself as the night cools it.
lines.chain: A chain dragging on the seabed, link by link.
lines.school: Forty thousand fish, turning at the same moment.
lines.tide: The tide, arriving twice a day, as promised.
lines.still: Here the tide turns... but nothing moves.
lines.echo-invite: Leave something for the sea to keep. Draw slowly.
lines.echo-kept: Kept. The ocean will remember this.
lines.echo-return: You have been here before. The sea kept your echo.
lines.answered: For the first time... someone answered.
